findings.body: `resolved_fingerprints` grows without a bound across a PR's lifetime, while `history` is capped to `IAR_HISTORY_MAX_ENTRIES` at embed time precisely "so the marker body cannot grow unboundedly" — the same rationale is not applied here (`embed_iteration_state` passes the fingerprint lists through verbatim). The state block lives inside a GitHub issue comment (65,536-char limit) and `gh_update_issue_comment` is best-effort, so an oversized block fails silently: the marker stays “Working…” and every later run classifies as `first_review`. Suggest capping/pruning at embed time mirroring the history cap, or cataloguing this under § 13 known limitations. Filing as info: the bar is high (~2.9k fingerprints at ~22 bytes each under `indent=2`) and the failure direction is over-review, never silenced findings.
